notes: Requires storageStateTracking: true at context creation and owned context access; untracked contexts and held virtual authenticators refuse before mutation. Preserves pages and URLs, replaces cookies/localStorage/IndexedDB and clears available OPFS across historical origins and partitions. Runtime failures have reason StorageState.PartiallyApplied; deadlines/interruption may also leave partial changes and pending database deletions may complete later. HTTP cache, existing-page sessionStorage and service-worker registrations remain unchanged; no credential or OPFS import. Incoming partitions explicitly marked crossSiteAncestor: false refuse. Not full Playwright equivalence.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; capability comparison preserves the notes on waiting, errors and identity.

decision.quote: Running writers and open storage handles can cause typed partial failure;
